dataset_requalification.explanation: Training arrays may be identical even though the physics-validation signature changes. Old model training provenance is retained; current validity comes from new expert/policy evaluations.

collision_fixes: Wall samples inside the vehicle footprint now count as collision, including at zero speed.
Ray distances use physical body length 0.57m instead of wheelbase 0.35m, with per-car LiDAR offset.
Approaching obstacles use a TTC horizon of at least one simulator timestep; receding obstacles are excluded.

strict_policy_diagnostics.note: Student alone controls the car. Expert labels are diagnostic comparisons on visited states; checkpoint is not an independently measured full lap.

experiment.description: Simulation-only training with per-episode randomized longitudinal response; assumptions, not calibrated physical limits.

assumptions.note: ERPM response cannot identify tire slip, ground speed or battery charge limits.

limitations: Response limits are assumed test cases, not estimates of physical braking capability.
No VESC electrical current loop, charge-current limit, fault trip or longitudinal tire slip is simulated.
Old rosbag averages cannot identify instantaneous overcurrent peaks or independent ground speed.
Expert and policy completion are separate results; all 23 evaluation tracks are training tracks.
Four-frame models are incompatible with the unchanged 1080-input ROS deployment node.
No obstacle-stop policy, sensor timing jitter robustness or physical 6m/s operation is established.

current_result.next_work: Improve imitation on failed corners and collect recovery states; retain existing Jetson model.
